_note: Source of truth for Dhanya's MCP connectors. Edit this file, then run: node ai-tools/install.mjs. Never put secrets here; use ${ENV_VAR}. On Windows, local servers start through 'cmd /c npx'.

github.purpose: Repos, pull requests, issues, Actions runs

playwright.purpose: Drive a real browser: try a flow by hand before writing a test, check a screen, debug a failing test

chrome-devtools.purpose: Speed checks, network and console inspection for the performance story

context7.purpose: Current library documentation, so cheaper models don't code from out-of-date memory

next-devtools.purpose: Next.js documentation and errors from the running dev server

Neon.purpose: Read-only look at Neon projects and databases. Signs in through the browser (OAuth); no key is stored. To allow changes, remove ?readonly=true and run node ai-tools/install.mjs

brevo-senders.purpose: Brevo email: sender addresses. Token is read from the Windows variable BREVO_MCP_TOKEN

brevo-templates.purpose: Brevo email: transactional email templates. Token is read from the Windows variable BREVO_MCP_TOKEN

brevo-domains.purpose: Brevo email: sending domains. Token is read from the Windows variable BREVO_MCP_TOKEN

supabase.purpose: Read-only look at Supabase projects. Not used by the plan (the database is Neon); here because the owner asked. Token is read from the Windows variable SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN

postgres-dev.enable_at: S0.3, once the local database and its read-only role exist
postgres-dev.purpose: Look at the LOCAL development database (Docker, port 5433). Uses a read-only database login, so it can't change data

vercel.purpose: Check deploys, logs and projects. Signs in through the browser (OAuth), no token stored

left_out_on_purpose.selenium: Playwright already covers real browsers, phone sizes and Safari's engine. Two tools would mean maintaining every test twice
left_out_on_purpose.neon: Left out until 2026-11-04. Now added read-only by the owner request. Never allow write access against the production project
left_out_on_purpose.server-postgres: The official package is archived and unmaintained
left_out_on_purpose.sentry: Skipped by the owner on 2026-11-04. Can be added later: a free account plus an entry for https://mcp.sentry.dev/mcp
